title: Improve your AI from the logs
blurb: Spot weak answers and fill the gaps in a weekly ten-minute check.

steps.title: Open AI Agents
steps.body: Click **AI Agents** in the left menu.

steps.title: Look at the last week
steps.body: Set the date filter to the last 7 days.

steps.title: Scan for trouble
steps.body: Open conversations that ended without a booking, or where the customer asked for a person.

steps.title: Find the cause
steps.body: Check whether it found knowledge for the question. No knowledge usually means a missing FAQ.

steps.title: Fill the gap
steps.body: Add the missing answer in **Knowledge Base** as an FAQ, or tighten the bot's instructions.
steps.tip: Repeat weekly for the first month. Answers improve fast.
